    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">一、红帽RHCSA+RHCE课前说明与Linux系统安装学习笔记</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">

<div class="lake-content">
<h2 id="Kk48F"><span class="ne-text">一、红帽认证体系</span></h2>
<h3 id="lQh1V"><span class="ne-text">1. 认证等级</span></h3>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u1a78e1b1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">初级：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">RHCSA 系统管理员</span></strong></li>
<li id="u05597718" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">中级：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">RHCE 工程师</span></strong></li>
<li id="u90f319f6" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">高级：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">RHCA 红帽架构师</span></strong></li>
<li id="u3bf1aea6" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">报考顺序：必须按 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">RHCSA → RHCE → RHCA</span></code><span class="ne-text">，不可直接考RHCA</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="dxfz6"><span class="ne-text">2. 课程学习内容</span></h3>
<h4 id="GhgzT"><span class="ne-text">RHCSA（占课程大部分时长）</span></h4>
<p id="u6c876759" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Linux系统安装、用户/用户组管理、文件管理、权限管理、文本处理工具、网络管理、磁盘管理、NFS共享存储、SELinux与防火墙安全管理、Podman容器技术</span></p>
<h4 id="g4tY6"><span class="ne-text">RHCE</span></h4>
<p id="uaa438494" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">仅核心学习</span><strong><span class="ne-text">Ansible自动化运维工具</span></strong><span class="ne-text"><br></span><span class="ne-text">包含：Ansible安装、配置文件与主机清单、常用模块、playbook编写、变量/判断/循环、jinja2模板、roles角色、collections集合、ansible-navigator容器化管理</span></p>
<h4 id="Lvk0S"><span class="ne-text">RHCA 多方向可选</span></h4>
<p id="u90a0dd8e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">云存储（Ceph）、云平台（OpenStack）、Linux系统调优、DevOps自动化部署等；需考过</span><strong><span class="ne-text">5门不同方向考试</span></strong><span class="ne-text">才可获取RHCA证书</span></p>
<h3 id="wYjah"><span class="ne-text">3. 课程周期与考试安排</span></h3>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u017ea187" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">课程周期：约2个月</span></li>
<li id="uae51ac2d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">考试形式：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">一天考完两门</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，上午RHCSA、下午RHCE，全程</span><strong><span class="ne-text">上机无笔试</span></strong></li>
<li id="u478c6e41" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">考试时长</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ub2d96d6c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCSA：3小时</span></li>
<li id="u41cd1509" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCE：4小时</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="4">
<li id="u9666e96b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">合格标准：满分300分，</span><strong><span class="ne-text">210分及格</span></strong></li>
<li id="u30014d09" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">证书规则</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u754b3fa8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">两门都过：拿RHCSA+RHCE两个证书</span></li>
<li id="u1a86b754" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">仅CSA过、CE挂：只拿RHCSA证书</span></li>
<li id="ubd1fcc82" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">任意一门挂科：无双证，</span><strong><span class="ne-text">挂哪门补考哪门</span></strong></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="6">
<li id="u43e9b8f8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">版本时间节点</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="uc00ef2c4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">2026.09.30前：可考RHEL9版本</span></li>
<li id="ucc00d580" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">2026.09.30后：只能考RHEL10版本</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="7">
<li id="ue0debe1c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHEL9与10考试差异</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u2e840e7f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCSA10：删减容器题，新增flatpak、root密码重置考题</span></li>
<li id="u0c28f333" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCE10：变化小，新增git、vscode相关内容</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="8">
<li id="u99697cce" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">考试成绩通知：考试当晚11点前或3天内，邮箱接收两门成绩邮件</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u0bab6190" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="553.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779632350481-322ef70a-404e-4cd6-8fa9-fb8e32013495.png"></p>
<h3 id="p2UD2"><span class="ne-text">4. 课程代码</span></h3>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u1a5d96b2" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCSA：124、134</span></li>
<li id="ucccad477" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCE：294</span></li>
<li id="ufc097bc3" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHCA：358、442、436、260、374</span></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="xD8m2"><span class="ne-text">5. 学习建议</span></h3>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u158d7695" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">空杯心态，从零开始学习</span></li>
<li id="u03875190" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">必须动手实操实验</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，切忌只看不学</span></li>
</ol>
<h1 id="kJJBj"><span class="ne-text">二、Linux系统基础介绍</span></h1>
<h2 id="GIJIP"><span class="ne-text">1. 操作系统核心作用</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u8f3f1ec8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">初始化识别硬件（CPU、内存、磁盘、网卡等）</span></li>
<li id="ufbc90ec5" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">提供软件运行环境，所有应用程序依赖操作系统运行</span></li>
<li id="u59bc1486" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">合理分配硬件系统资源</span></li>
<li id="u38f24316" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">操作系统核心是</span><strong><span class="ne-text">内核</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<h2 id="vAQY5"><span class="ne-text">2. Linux与Windows核心区别</span></h2>
<table id="CqJ9J" class="ne-table">
<tbody>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="ue1b0f117" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">对比项</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u235f58f6" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Linux</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u7a73972b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Windows</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u4df055bf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">开源属性</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="ud7ea5754" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">开源，仅内核开源，可定制二次开发</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u6748c852" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">闭源，源码不公开</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u2492e9c5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">应用场景</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u712d8011" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">主打</span><strong><span class="ne-text">服务器领域</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，稳定性强、可7×24小时运行</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u27498e9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">主打个人桌面端，上手简单</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u6d1144dc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">更新机制</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u285d8935" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">手动可控更新</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="uc121582d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">自动强制更新居多</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td width="250">
<p id="u7129420b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">收费模式</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u80cfca0b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">内核免费，技术服务/订阅收费</span></p>
</td>
<td width="250">
<p id="u1a295533" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">系统正版需付费</span></p>
</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 id="aHH9g"><span class="ne-text">3. 开源协议</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="uadf7cff7" data-lake-index-type="0"><strong><span class="ne-text">GNU GPL</span></strong><span class="ne-text">：Linux内核采用，使用其代码的软件必须开源</span></li>
<li id="u3daa715d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">BSD：可修改、二开、商业化，无强制开源要求</span></li>
<li id="ua9286353" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Apache：可修改二开商业化，需标注代码修改位置</span></li>
<li id="u8c671c4b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">MIT：可修改二开商业化，需保留原作者信息</span></li>
</ol>
<h2 id="JVk24"><span class="ne-text">4. 红帽公司及Linux发行版</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="ufbf93a91" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">红帽是知名开源企业，靠</span><strong><span class="ne-text">技术服务订阅</span></strong><span class="ne-text">盈利</span></li>
<li id="u206da54e" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">旗下产品：RHEL、Fedora、CentOS Stream、Ceph、OpenShift、Ansible、Podman</span></li>
<li id="u0730889d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Linux发行版本质：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">Linux内核 + 定制软件</span></strong></li>
<li id="u3851e733" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">两大发行版系列</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u8fa8ac49" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">RHEL系（rpm包、yum/dnf工具）：RHEL、CentOS、RockyLinux</span></li>
<li id="u69417f6b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Debian系（deb包、apt工具）：Debian、Ubuntu</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="5">
<li id="ubcb560fc" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">红帽系统上下游关系</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u49202c8f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">旧版：Fedora → RHEL → CentOS</span></li>
<li id="u851977a0" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">新版：Fedora → CentOS Stream → RHEL</span></li>
<li id="u7a07ca1d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">生产环境</span><strong><span class="ne-text">不推荐CentOS Stream</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，稳定性不足</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="6">
<li id="ufd3eaae8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">国产系统特性：基于开源rpm工具、bash shell，命令通用，非抄袭</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u6795530b" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="553.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779632381103-875df276-c7ea-420a-859d-4c229b7b2e94.png"></p>
<h2 id="ZJXIQ"><span class="ne-text">5. 课程环境</span></h2>
<p id="uf90c48d9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">本次课程使用 </span><strong><span class="ne-text">RHEL 9.3</span></strong><span class="ne-text"> 学习</span></p>
<h1 id="lHMK8"><span class="ne-text">三、RHEL9.3 安装准备</span></h1>
<h2 id="N8pEP"><span class="ne-text">1. 红帽账号与镜像下载</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="uab84dd8d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">官网地址：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">access.redhat.com</span></code><span class="ne-text">，需注册账号并开通</span><strong><span class="ne-text">免费开发者订阅</span></strong><span class="ne-text">（有效期1年）</span></li>
<li id="uf9615fc7" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">镜像类型</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ub974c7af" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">rhel-9.3-x86_64-dvd.iso：完整版镜像，离线安装必备（9.81GB）</span></li>
<li id="u3a3d5685" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">boot.iso：网络安装镜像，需联网拉取安装包</span></li>
<li id="uac8482b6" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">qcow2：KVM虚拟机专用模板镜像</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="3">
<li id="ub928f994" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">配套驱动：virtio-win 镜像，提升虚拟机硬件兼容性</span></li>
</ol>
<h2 id="kMWZq"><span class="ne-text">2. VMware虚拟机环境配置</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u727886b8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">虚拟化软件：VMware Workstation</span></li>
<li id="u18dd27be" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">虚拟网络：VMnet8 NAT模式，子网172.10.0.0/24</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="uc77f0a21" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1100.6666666666667" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779632872933-a1301b8b-0716-4026-97ab-dc7f31e0e48a.png"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="3">
<li id="u3fb4285e" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">硬件配置：内存4GB、CPU 2核、硬盘100GB、网卡NAT模式</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u7ae5ade8" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="475.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633313486-ac38f5a7-3540-4410-9bae-37151a5f98c1.png"></p>
<p id="u805a1676" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">选择最新的就好，这个其实就是选择你的主板（内存，处理器.....）</span></p>
<p id="ubbd33400" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="485.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633361645-6560e413-ab9d-4273-980f-3b1e44b62d42.png"></p>
<p id="ud1eec10d" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="u35d3ac31" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">客户机其实就是虚拟机，Guest</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="479.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633427056-dd3174fc-d15a-40c4-b0ef-596929e01828.png"></p>
<p id="u3c16dfab" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="472" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633487982-635a77c6-f57e-499f-814e-afab2bd5199d.png"></p>
<p id="uef623672" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="479.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633581124-99151bb1-dd1d-49e9-b4cd-bacb0879cb1a.png"></p>
<p id="u1ee123c5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">操作系统只看内核总数</span></p>
<p id="u3f98c3b3" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="478" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633599059-1d591a2f-0a4e-46de-991c-8f66de80dcd8.png"></p>
<p id="ue8475e16" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">在我的VM虚拟机设置不要超过我的物理机就行，我这里是不超过16</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1089.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633723306-2bcbfdfe-7878-4429-9dba-4b883d7ad3d5.png"></p>
<p id="u11b27a64" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里我们内存给大一点，给个4G</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="472.6666666666667" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633845231-85ad7145-e14c-49df-9739-9b3ae61583e7.png"></p>
<p id="u1d2214ab" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">保持默认</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="473.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633917231-6406afbc-07a3-469f-ba90-a40d1d9302cf.png"></p>
<p id="u0b5c6c3b" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="480" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779633952462-fd98dfec-e85b-43bd-9f7e-d39d77c3c4db.png"></p>
<p id="u9c311c4d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里随便选，不选第一个就行</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="476" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634005977-b99dcfc1-2ccc-4b06-902b-90c8b8332a77.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="474" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634016727-6f4385e5-a606-4bc9-8ade-8f774e06ac29.png"></p>
<p id="u130d6837" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="478" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634037049-fd1b3b85-ed37-40b8-9fd6-6726e13cf960.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="480.6666666666667" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634046369-2da9b453-6459-4b60-8239-d87681088388.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="473.3333333333333" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634212711-fcc57351-52d6-4856-bab5-e610af815f7e.png"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="4">
<li id="uc6a82560" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">固件模式：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">选择BIOS</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，暂不使用UEFI（UEFI需额外划分/boot/efi分区）</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="ufbcac5fb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">安装系统的时候如果选择的启动模式不一样，安装系统选择的分区也会不一样，当代服务器和个人电脑启动模式都是UEFI，目前设置位BIOS即可</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1032.6666666666667" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634576791-93ec94a3-c134-4955-be56-702e4890b56c.png"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="5">
<li id="u749d8273" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">选择ISO 镜像文件</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="700" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634631386-d47cba08-b506-4f73-80c5-802f4f4423c6.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="697.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634655708-ec9887b3-5a0a-4e04-bb12-3fbf54f7ca2a.png"></li>
<li id="ua35035d1" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">然后正常开机即可如果比较卡，关闭这个3F 图形功能</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="670.6666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779634839931-dc68898d-8770-423f-84e6-55dd713471c7.png"></li>
</ol>
<p id="u4fa7e71f" class="ne-p"></p>
<h1 id="hnRfG"><span class="ne-text">四、RHEL9.3 系统安装步骤</span></h1>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u5b19ef9d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">启动选项</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u2174e01f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Install RHEL9.3：直接安装</span></li>
<li id="u3d456a43" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Test this media &amp; install：校验镜像完整性后安装（生产环境推荐）</span></li>
<li id="u8855cb97" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Troubleshooting：救援模式、文本模式安装、内存检测</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u9b4c09f5" data-lake-index-type="0"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="396.6666666666667" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779635024241-26d69609-7396-4295-97e7-3c40e638e38a.png"></li>
<li id="u244e734b" data-lake-index-type="0"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="342.6666666666667" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779635178232-cd56778f-cf13-4810-893d-d37bc33b8fe7.png"></li>
</ul>
<p id="u670f3309" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">扩展救援模式知识点</span></p>
<p id="u30781184" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="368" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779635360123-f38c8ae1-a718-45b6-b7b0-0eade0219fb2.png"></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u50be3496" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">第一个表示用命令行方式安装系统，只能通过键盘方式来选择操作，这个方式时候老设备</span></li>
<li id="u8f26fbd4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">第二个表示救援一个RHEL 系统，后面学习故障修复回使用</span></li>
<li id="u9e31be62" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">第三个检查内存清空</span></li>
<li id="u0ab85985" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">第四给从当前磁盘去加载</span></li>
<li id="u87d33173" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">第五个return表示返回主菜单</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u1003d197" class="ne-p"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="4">
<li id="u2e4b1c17" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">语言选择：可选择中文/英文，</span><strong><span class="ne-text">安装语言决定系统默认语言</span></strong></li>
</ol>
<p id="u0816fe49" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">建议选择英文</span></p>
<p id="uc1d3b16d" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="848" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779635875159-2949575f-d252-4414-b6e1-19333fab6a7f.png"></p>
<p id="u336d34d1" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="u1bfc4004" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">这里可以+ 支持 中文</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="863.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779636454201-f0333fdf-cee1-402f-a3fe-f1c9525c10a3.png"></p>
<p id="u18e52217" class="ne-p"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="5">
<li id="u0950fe92" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">时区选择上海</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="860.6666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779636526445-78246829-fb88-4784-9022-c04e06986849.png"></li>
</ol>
<p id="u70ffbd96" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="628.6666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779636567569-3d1cb697-e143-47fc-b905-bbba54a4f78a.png"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="6">
<li id="uf17e2f01" data-lake-index-type="0"></li>
<li id="u3c06bdab" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">软件选择</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u8b7e024c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Server with GUI：带GNOME图形化桌面（红帽默认桌面）</span></li>
<li id="u394a7d3e" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Server：纯服务器无桌面</span></li>
<li id="uda752510" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Minimal Install：最小化安装（无桌面、最简组件）</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="8">
<li id="ue38d2840" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Kdump：内核崩溃日志收集机制，默认开启</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="u878cfd11" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">当操作系统内核面临崩溃的时候，</span><span class="ne-text">Kdump会收集内核的信息保存到一个目录下/var/crash/</span></p>
<p id="u0bb4bf28" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">你可以把这个文件给到红帽的工程师去看，让别人根据文件判断内核为什么崩溃</span></p>
<p id="u70198a4f" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="846" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779637778025-d72bbf21-168c-46f1-a2b0-6d52fb4b5e67.png"></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u9e6b6c58" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">我这里就随便选择个软件吧</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="849.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779637522986-80e7a2c7-e61a-452c-b7ce-234e2e38f419.png"></li>
<li id="u3f70eaec" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">安全策略关闭（生存环境也不会去开他）</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="862" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779637725250-4a5d8470-7b2f-46ca-85f5-8fffb41e9ca9.png"></li>
<li id="u5ad7982d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">安装磁盘分区</span></li>
</ul>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u56de3ad4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">BIOS模式最少分区：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/boot</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 启动分区、</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 根分区</span></li>
<li id="uac4e5411" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">UEFI模式额外增加：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/boot/efi</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 分区</span></li>
<li id="u46d5ca2b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">常用额外分区：/home普通用户家目录、/var日志缓存分区、swap交换分区（硬盘充当内存）</span></li>
<li id="u644114e7" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">分区方式：Automatic自动分区（逻辑卷）、Custom手动分区（重点掌握）</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<p id="uf1d717d7" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="u8ef1883a" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="u4b83bb7d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">BIOS模式手动配置分区示例：</span></p>
<p id="u550e531b" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="855.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779639961659-cda6ce23-e496-414d-a132-f5492092f7f5.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="852.6666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640027017-913ffbaa-ff31-48d8-bc71-a8ec1c91d097.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="844.6666666666666" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640067335-cdac499f-e331-441b-acde-b96c46894a41.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="858" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640234046-98cdd824-893f-4989-9dcc-e0f2f23b4cf3.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="854" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640285258-93cc349f-733b-4a8a-aef9-74ce5120d737.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="861.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640682700-71ea520e-8cc1-4950-962d-015958a112e8.png"></p>
<p id="ua262030b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">接受保存</span></p>
<p id="ud86eb1d3" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="847.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640762635-22260514-7a98-49ce-ab09-4143ac380c3a.png"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="12">
<li id="u41efda6c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">Root用户设置</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u99da86ff" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">设置root密码，RHEL9默认</span><strong><span class="ne-text">禁止root密码SSH远程登录</span></strong></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<p id="u6a041452" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">默认禁止远程登入，我们这里勾选一下SHH远程</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ub75a0d34" data-lake-index-type="0"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="864" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779640863078-f4738328-8d91-46be-afd7-25120a6e25ee.png"></li>
<li id="uad75ff81" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">普通用户：GUI安装不创建用户，进系统后会强制创建；最小化安装无强制要求</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="ua7f51340" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Full name是描述信息</span></p>
<p id="uea2b9cb4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">User name是用户名</span></p>
<p id="u62df7684" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="512" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779641021189-67d6bfe0-fc59-42d2-bb76-65b718e7787e.png"></p>
<p id="udd6760c1" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="u99a01242" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">完成以上设置，下一步开始安装</span></p>
<p id="ucab849c0" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="851.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779641119717-531990c6-6765-4dd6-811f-aa718c3df9d9.png"></p>
<p id="u0072cd22" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="uf019b587" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">拍摄快照，这是最重要的一点</span><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="687.3333333333334" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779864908778-8b39c250-48d8-409c-a4ed-022d6b5e02b9.png"></p>
<h1 id="AcbVT"><span class="ne-text">五、Linux系统登录方式</span></h1>
<h2 id="JoKp7"><span class="ne-text">1. 图形化本地登录</span></h2>
<p id="u966c52d4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">直连显示器、键盘鼠标，适用于机房物理服务器</span></p>
<h2 id="cp14g"><span class="ne-text">2. SSH远程命令行登录</span></h2>
<p id="u1325e8b7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">Windows使用SSH工具，通过服务器IP远程连接，仅命令行模式</span></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ua018eae2" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">查看网卡IP：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ifconfig</span></code></li>
</ul>
<p id="u81e39a09" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="750" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779690588850-44398f44-d90c-4611-b8c3-1d4ecf021b55.png"></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u73b588dd" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">测试连通性：Windows cmd </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">ping 服务器IP</span></code></li>
</ul>
<p id="u3e0c9439" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1634" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779692472609-f84aa245-868b-4ada-b546-06172641010a.png"></p>
<h2 id="XKIvk"><span class="ne-text">3. 本地命令行登录</span></h2>
<p id="u06d29e63" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">无桌面环境下，虚拟机控制台直接账号密码登录</span></p>
<h2 id="D5xFa"><span class="ne-text">4. Cockpit浏览器控制台登录</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u6ed907b5" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">启动服务：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">systemctl enable --now cockpit.socket</span></code></li>
<li id="u749b6177" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">访问方式：浏览器输入 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">https://服务器IP:9090</span></code><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1543" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779692876064-1eb22d49-4a36-4608-82ab-45d0fd2f2995.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1169" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779692934027-8ba2928a-5052-4a14-b02f-f559abe4f318.png"></li>
<li id="u61765aa8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">权限限制：RHEL9默认禁止root登录，需修改 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">/etc/cockpit/disallowed-users</span></code><span class="ne-text"> 删除root字段</span></li>
</ol>
<p id="uad401d0b" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="625" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779693148412-1f6cff92-9d63-4d9c-8e8b-70c19f2147be.png"></p>
<p id="u20d857bd" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="572" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779693123245-b5913961-7f67-41cc-a8b1-95f596573e6c.png"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1136" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779693180852-4a9a02f0-ac17-4921-82b7-6e68f8f9ad41.png"></p>
<h1 id="bgx2N"><span class="ne-text">六、命令提示符详解</span></h1>
<p id="u6330c605" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">格式：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">[root@lab ~]#</span></code></p>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u2da1bb54" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">root：当前登录用户名</span></li>
<li id="u95af9ba3" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">@：分隔符</span></li>
<li id="ube3eb2e0" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">lab：主机名</span></li>
<li id="u2021415f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">~：当前目录，</span><strong><span class="ne-text">代表用户家目录</span></strong></li>
</ul>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ue0bfafa5" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">root家目录：/root</span></li>
<li id="u521b6a6d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">普通用户家目录：/home/用户名</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u7d4869ad" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">#：超级管理员root提示符</span></li>
<li id="u8ca8d5b8" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">$：普通用户提示符</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u840024bf" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">只显示点前面的主机名</span></p>
<p id="ufd69a450" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">adsl-172-10-0-128.dsl.sndg02.sbcglobal.net<br></span><span class="ne-text">显示root@adsl-172-10-0-128</span></p>
<p id="u132c591e" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="1409" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779694578966-6dcb8d38-2e67-4668-9576-a6c117e8b2a1.png"></p>
<h1 id="g02bx"><span class="ne-text">七、Linux虚拟控制台</span></h1>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u9ee339f4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">共6个虚拟控制台</span></li>
</ol>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u01e51458" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">F1：系统登录页面</span></li>
<li id="u162e0a7b" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">F2：图形化桌面（安装桌面且登录后生效）</span></li>
<li id="ua28b7fe2" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">F3~F6：纯命令行控制台</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="2">
<li id="u4d810bba" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">切换快捷键：</span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Ctrl+Alt+F1~F6</span></code><span class="ne-text">，笔记本需加Fn键</span></li>
</ol>
<h1 id="Foe8X"><span class="ne-text">八、基础Linux命令实操</span></h1>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ud3b8c94d" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">date 显示日期</span></li>
<li id="uce72e949" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">cal 显示日历</span></li>
<li id="u57764344" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">useradd 创建用户</span></li>
<li id="u041c3c3c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">su - 切换用户</span></li>
<li id="uc22faa1f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">id 查看用户信息</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="u7b69cacc" class="ne-p"></p>
<p id="ufaeefe76" class="ne-p"></p>
<h2 id="gFown" data-lake-index-type="2">1. <span class="ne-text">date和cal示例</span></h2>
<pre id="Dh86b" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>date
cal</code></pre>
<p id="u1fde501e" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="377" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779695202332-f20dae0d-a086-44d3-96c1-7711994f61c5.png"></p>
<h2 id="dfry8" data-lake-index-type="2">2. <span class="ne-text">用户创建 useradd</span></h2>
<p id="uaa6ebc69" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">仅root可执行，执行无回显即成功</span></p>
<pre id="KDT1k" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>useradd zhangsan
#创建用户
useradd lisi

id zhangsan
# 查看对应用户是否存在
id memeda
#查看对应用户不存在</code></pre>
<p id="u96f13997" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="558" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779695452280-2f723cee-9f4e-4598-9c9d-be7e01b38d4d.png"></p>
<h2 id="UwNxq" data-lake-index-type="2">3. <span class="ne-text"> 密码设置 passwd</span></h2>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="ua7411247" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">root改密码</span></li>
</ol>
<pre id="tRdof" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>passwd zhangsan</code></pre>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u33023f4f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">可修改所有用户密码</span></li>
<li id="u7d5e77ae" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">无需验证旧密码、</span><strong><span class="ne-text">不遵循密码策略</span></strong></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<p id="u7265293e" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="486" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779695589494-33d11dc4-d556-43d6-b935-0ae36c00e22b.png"></p>
<ol class="ne-ol" start="2">
<li id="ucb6f3c96" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">普通用户改密码</span></li>
</ol>
<pre id="Fyxh0" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code>passwd  # 普通用户仅输入passwd，不能加用户名</code></pre>
<ul class="ne-list-wrap">
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="ufe9a45af" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">只能改自己密码</span></li>
<li id="u32c0714c" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">需验证旧密码、必须遵循密码策略（长度、不能含用户名）</span></li>
</ul>
</ul>
<p id="ucb751424" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="422" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779695703880-e052b479-8e45-4c64-baa6-110d6ba09f3b.png"></p>
<h2 id="TFz0P" data-lake-index-type="2">4. <span class="ne-text"> 切换用户 su -</span></h2>
<pre id="QA79k" class="ne-codeblock language-bash highlighter-hljs" data-language="bash"><code># root切普通用户，无需密码
su - zhangsan
# 普通用户切其他用户，必须验证密码
su - lisi</code></pre>
<h3 id="aAWKv"><span class="ne-text">切换规则</span></h3>
<ul class="ne-ul">
<li id="u672a68d4" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">root → 任意用户：免密码</span></li>
<li id="u50db8b28" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">普通用户 → 其他用户：需密码验证</span></li>
</ul>
<p id="ud2a56a74" class="ne-p"><img class="ne-image lazyload" width="422" data-src="https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/0/2026/png/59621818/1779695713947-fc689252-ac09-45c0-b801-8626614bb60e.png"></p>
<h1 id="SREPq"><span class="ne-text">九、课后练习</span></h1>
<ol class="ne-ol">
<li id="u44bb8841" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">root登录，将自身密码改为 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">1</span></code></li>
<li id="uc5528c7f" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">创建用户 memeda01、memeda02，密码均设为 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">redhat</span></code></li>
<li id="ucbedb856" data-lake-index-type="0"><span class="ne-text">切换至memeda01，自行修改密码为 </span><code class="ne-code"><span class="ne-text">Huawei12#$</span></code></li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
